title: The 760 Score Secret Banks Won't Tell You — $23K
hook: Everyone's chasing 750 — but banks use a completely different cutoff, and missing it will cost you $23,000.
angle: The hidden credit score pricing tier at 760 that unlocks best mortgage rates — and the 31% of Americans with 'good' credit stuck just below it without knowing
audience: Anyone who owns or plans to buy a home and thinks 750 is the goal
key_numbers: 760 is the actual threshold for best mortgage rates (not 750)
31% of Americans score 700–759 — one tier too low
$23,000 extra interest on a $400K mortgage if you score 759 vs 760
